metrics.label: Net-new funded vs quota
metrics.definition: Accounts reaching FUNDED in the period credited to the rep ÷ prorated quota (quota_funded_annual × days_elapsed/365). Liquidity-partner accounts count at 0.25.

metrics.label: Activation rate (funded → Active ≤60d)
metrics.definition: Of the rep's accounts funded ≥60 days ago, share that reached Active (≥4 distinct trading days in trailing 30) within 60 days of funding. Cohorts with n<5 per rep shown but flagged.

metrics.label: Book ADV vs target
metrics.definition: 20-trading-day ADV (contracts, non-self-match, LP volume excluded) across the rep's book ÷ rep quota_adv.

metrics.label: Median days signature → first qualifying trade
metrics.definition: Median calendar days from signed_at to first_qualifying_trade_at (≥10 contracts) for the rep's accounts that traded in the trailing 180 days. Target = 10 (sign→KYC) + 5 (KYC→funded) + 10 (funded→trade).

metrics.label: Qualified pipeline coverage
metrics.definition: Accounts in QUALIFIED or SIGNED owned by the rep ÷ remaining funded quota for the next 90 days (quota_funded_annual × 90/365).

metrics.label: NBA SLA adherence
metrics.definition: Share of next-best-action items assigned to the rep in the trailing 30 days completed (activity logged) within the rule's sla_hours.

scoring: component = min(actual / target, 1.5) for direction 'higher'; min(target / actual, 1.5) for 'lower' (actual ≤ 0 → 1.5). score = Σ weight × component, reported 0–150 with 100 = on plan. A component below 0.5 turns red regardless of total score.
